Russia condemns Larijani killing, dodges Iran aid claims as tensions surge
world news
Published on Mar 19, 2026 11:02 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
Dmitry Peskov responds to rising tensions after the killing of Ali Larijani, with Russia condemning attacks on Iran’s leadership while dismissing reports of aiding Tehran as “disinformation.” As speculation grows over Vladimir Putin supporting Mojtaba Khamenei, the Kremlin avoids direct answers on intelligence sharing. Moscow also rejects a European role in Ukraine peace talks, while signaling openness to dialogue. With Middle East conflict escalating and global energy markets shaken, geopolitical tensions continue to intensify.
